title: The Footing That Held 614 kPa, Not 331
featured_title: THE FOOTING THAT HELD 614 KPA NOT 331
subject: civil

presentation.challenge: Using only the surcharge term gave 331 kPa. The width-dependent soil-weight term raised the gross ultimate bearing capacity to about 614 kPa.

practice.primary_question: How is gross ultimate bearing capacity of a strip footing calculated using the given bearing-capacity factors?
practice.typical_exam_trap: Using only qNq for cohesionless soil and omitting the 0.5 gamma B Ngamma term.

case_dna.target_misconception: For a cohesionless strip footing, gross ultimate bearing capacity is only gamma Df Nq.
case_dna.why_plausible: The surcharge term is prominent and cohesion is zero, but the soil-weight term remains nonzero.
case_dna.contradicting_evidence: With gamma=18, Df=1 m, B=2 m, Nq=18.4, and Ngamma=15.7, q_ult=331.2+282.6=613.8 kPa.
case_dna.corrected_model: For the formula specified in this case, q_ult=gamma Df Nq+0.5 gamma B Ngamma when c=0.

problem_statement: A 2.0 m wide strip footing is embedded 1.0 m in cohesionless soil with unit weight gamma=18 kN/m³. Use Nq=18.4 and Ngamma=15.7 and the specified relation q_ult=gamma Df Nq+0.5 gamma B Ngamma. Determine gross ultimate bearing capacity and gross allowable pressure for FS=3.

gates.label: Incident
gates.heading: The surcharge term was calculated, but the soil-weight term disappeared.
gates.prompt: Which nonzero term remains even when c=0?

options.label: q_ult=gamma Df Nq+0.5 gamma B Ngamma
options.reason: Both terms are present for the stated cohesionless strip-footing formula.

options.label: q_ult=gamma Df Nq only
options.reason: This omits the width-dependent soil-weight contribution.

options.label: q_ult=0.5 gamma B Ngamma only
options.reason: This omits surcharge from embedment depth.

gates.label: Experiment
gates.heading: Assemble both bearing-capacity contributions
gates.result: Gross ultimate bearing capacity is 613.8 kPa.

gates.label: Gap
gates.heading: Prove the capacity
gates.hint: Do not drop the Ngamma term.

claims.label: C3
claims.reason: It omits 0.5 gamma B Ngamma=282.6 kPa.

correction.template: q_ult={ultimate} kPa and q_allow={allowable} kPa for FS=3.

gates.label: Design Fix
gates.heading: Increase footing width to 3.0 m
gates.constraint: Keep Df, gamma, Nq, Ngamma, and FS unchanged.

options.label: Gross allowable pressure becomes about 251.7 kPa
It stays 204.6 kPa
options.reason: The Ngamma term increases with width.

gates.label: Transfer
gates.heading: Apply the stated formula again
gates.prompt: For B=1.5 m with all other inputs unchanged, what is q_ult?

options.label: 331.2 kPa
options.reason: That again omits the width-dependent term.

gates.explanation: The stated bearing-capacity model includes both surcharge and soil-weight contributions.

gates.label: Sign Off
gates.heading: Sign off the foundation calculation
gates.confirmation: I confirm that the specified cohesionless strip-footing formula includes both qNq and 0.5 gamma B Ngamma terms.

items.label: What failed
items.value: The soil-weight bearing-capacity term was omitted.

items.label: What was missed
items.value: Footing width contributes through 0.5 gamma B Ngamma.

items.label: Corrected model
items.value: Use the full stated bearing-capacity relation before applying factor of safety.

seo.seo_title: Strip Footing Bearing Capacity | FE Civil E-103
seo.meta_description: Solve FE Civil E-103: a 2 m strip footing in cohesionless soil has gross ultimate bearing capacity 613.8 kPa and allowable pressure 204.6 kPa for FS=3.
seo.focus_keyphrase: FE Civil strip footing bearing capacity
seo.excerpt: For the stated cohesionless strip-footing formula, omitting the soil-weight term can nearly halve the calculated capacity.
seo.direct_answer: q_ult=18(1)(18.4)+0.5(18)(2)(15.7)=613.8 kPa. For FS=3, gross allowable pressure is 204.6 kPa.

faqs.q: What terms remain for a cohesionless strip footing in the stated formula?
faqs.a: The surcharge term gamma Df Nq and the soil-weight term 0.5 gamma B Ngamma.
